title.narrative: Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Company (PCRIC) operationalized
PCRIC makes full insurance payout within a 30 days of the occurence of a covered (insured) event
The claims paying capacity of the PCRIC is enough to sustain a 1-in-200 year insured loss
Number of additional countries purchasing insurance per season
PCRIC total equity is projected to increase through FY24
